topic: What Google looks for before showing you in the map pack
caption:
Consistency wins the map pack.
Google cross-checks your business info across dozens of sites before ranking you locally. One wrong phone number on Yelp can cost you that top spot.
Audit your listings this week. Fix what doesn't match.
DM us 'MAP' if you want help getting this right.
